observations.behavior: Adds a status-code-only check for HTTP 429 in the rate-limit detection, alongside the existing Meta-specific JSON error parsing.
observations.posthog_connection: The Meta Ads warehouse ingestion connector, which periodically polls Meta's Graph API, could encounter a fronting proxy that returns a bare 429 status with an HTML body instead of Meta's expected JSON. This could cause the ingestion to fail or retry indefinitely without recognizing the throttling. This hunk adds a fallback: if the status is 429, treat it immediately as a rate-limit
